senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. אֲרִיתָא) channel, river, esp. the Nile.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> (ref. to <he>מיער</he> with suspended <cite ref="P00000"><he>ע</he></cite>, <cite ref="Psalms 80:14">Ps. LXXX, 14</cite>) <he>אם זכיתם מן הי׳ … מן היער</he> if you will do good, the enemy attacking you will be (powerless like an animal) coming from the river, if not, he will be like a beast of the forest; Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 830">Yalk. Ps. 830</cite>; <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 34:4">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXXIV</cite> <he>כחזיר של י׳</he> like a water swine (pork-fish, silurus).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 9:11">Ex. R. s. 9</cite> <he>המים ששמרוך … לי׳ וכ׳</he> the waters which saved thee (Moses) when thou wast thrown into the Nile, must not be smitten through thee; a. fr.
